title: Retrieving Data: Queries, Collections aur Pagination
objectives: Eloquent Collection ke useful methods jaanna

sections.heading: Basic retrieval
sections.body: Query builder ke saare methods Eloquent par bhi chalte hain, par rows ki jagah model objects milte hain.
explain: `all()` bahut badi table par mat chalao, saari rows memory mein aayengi.
`find` null de sakta hai, `findOrFail` 404 deta hai (controllers mein behtar).

sections.heading: Collections
sections.body: `get()` aur `all()` ek **Eloquent Collection** dete hain, jisme array se zyada powerful methods hote hain.
explain: Agar filter database mein ho sakta hai, to `where()` use karo (tez). Collection ka `filter` sab rows memory mein laane ke baad chalta hai.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Search aur filter page
sections.body: Products page par optional search aur min price filter. `when()` condition true ho tabhi query mein clause jodta hai, to `if` ke jhanjhat se bachte ho.
explain: `filled('q')` – input maujood aur khali nahi hai.
`paginate(10)` – 10 per page. `withQueryString()` – page badalne par `?q=...` filters bane rehte hain.

sections.heading: Badi tables: chunk aur lazy
sections.body: Lakhon rows par loop chalana ho to saari rows ek saath mat lao:

callout.text: Rule: pehle `where` se database mein filter karo, phir `paginate`/`chunk`. Collection mein laakar filter karna aakhri raasta hai.

versionDiff.heading: Retrieval: Laravel 11, 12, 13
versionDiff.intro: Retrieval methods, collections aur pagination teeno versions mein same hain.

errors.error: Call to a member function update() on null
errors.cause: `find()` ne null diya (id nahi mili) aur tumne seedha method call kiya.
errors.fix: `findOrFail()` use karo ya null check karo.

errors.cause: `all()` ya `get()` se bahut saari rows memory mein aa gayi.

errors.error: Pagination links page badalne par filter hata deti hain

debug.body: Query ki SQL dekhne ke liye `toSql()`, `dd()` ya Tinker mein result seedha dekho.

tasks: `/products` route banao jo `paginate(10)` se products dikhaye

quiz.q: `findOrFail()` id na mile to kya karta hai?
quiz.why: `findOrFail` `ModelNotFoundException` throw karta hai jo 404 banta hai.

options: Condition true ho to hi clause jodta hai

quiz.q: Bahut badi table par loop ke liye kya better hai?
quiz.why: `chunk()`/`lazy()` rows ko hisson mein laate hain.

interview.a: `find` null deta hai. `findOrFail` na milne par exception (404).
`get()` collection, `first()` sirf pehla model ya null.
`paginate` total count aur page numbers deta hai. `simplePaginate` sirf next/previous, ek COUNT query bachti hai.

interview.q: Collection filter aur `where` mein kya better?
interview.a: `where` database mein filter karta hai (tez, kam memory). Collection filter sab rows laane ke baad chalta hai.
Bahut saari rows par kaam karna ho aur memory bachani ho.

summary: `when()` optional filters ka saaf tareeka hai.
`withQueryString()` se pagination filters yaad rakhti hai.
